purpose: Define the generic invariant for stable machine-significant entity identities independently from labels, addresses, aliases, storage locations and runtime handles.

topics.name: Semantic Entity Identity
topics.purpose: Define the generic invariant for stable machine-significant entity identities independently from labels, addresses, aliases, storage locations and runtime handles.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant semantic entity uses an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.label_rule: Human names/labels are mutable presentation metadata.
semantics.address_rule: Addresses/paths/URIs are locators or bindings, not identity unless an exact contract declares otherwise.
semantics.runtime_rule: PID/socket/object-memory handles are runtime metadata only.
semantics.revision_rule: Compatible revisions may preserve identity while exact content revision remains separately identifiable.
semantics.collision_rule: Two active incompatible semantic entities cannot silently share one canonical identity.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: display name used as canonical identity
runtime handle serialized as semantic identity
